Nine cases ran from the earlier definition file (sha256 a929922b…), whose prompts are identical to the current file except implicit and project-destination, which were rerun from the current file.
chat-only: the reply said it read the code and did not run the tests; the pass conditions do not require running them.

evidence.visibility: Local-only; raw traces, fixtures and absolute paths are not committed.

environment.context_mode_or_jev: Not installed in the test sessions. integrations.md loading was not exercised.
